record.question: Article 371G was inserted into the Constitution of India through the:
record.answerKeyRef: MCS Combined 2023 Preliminary Exam Answer Key Paper-I Series 'A'..pdf
record.explanation:
The Constitution (Fifty-third Amendment) Act, 1986 inserted Article 371G after Article 371F. Article 371G sets Mizoram-specific protections concerning specified Mizo religious or social practices, customary law, certain justice matters, and land ownership or transfer, and fixes a minimum Assembly strength of 40. The amendment’s commencement was notified for 20 February 1987; the exam asks which Amendment Act inserted it, not the effective date.

Reference: https://www.legislative.gov.in/static/uploads/2025/07/f1b620ba6a4d19f4fc9b83bb1d892160.pdf
